# Honeyfil

> Honeyfil is a plant-based dietary supplement formulated to support healthy circulation, everyday stamina, and masculine vitality in men. Sold exclusively at honey--fil.com.

## About
Honeyfil combines eight plant-based ingredients — including Panax Ginseng, L-Citrulline, Pine Bark Extract, and Tribulus Terrestris — into a single daily capsule. The formula is designed to support nitric oxide pathways, cellular energy production, and healthy stress response. Manufactured in the United States in an FDA-registered, GMP-certified facility using non-GMO ingredients.

## Key Facts
- Product: Honeyfil (dietary supplement, capsule form)
- Category: Men's circulation, vitality, and energy support
- Serving size: 1 capsule daily, 60 capsules per bottle (30-day supply)
- Guarantee: 60-day money-back guarantee
- Availability: Exclusively at honey--fil.com; not sold in retail stores
- Pricing tiers: 1 bottle, 3 bottles (most popular), 6 bottles (best value)
